answer: Because the meadow reference is updated at each crystal checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the ferrous audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 2 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 111 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
